purpose: Assemble the original full-body kingdom guard, original procedural five-clip motion, original sword and shield, and authored surface materials into a reviewable Blender and browser-ready candidate.

authorship.model: Derived only from the project-authored Hunyuan3D-2.1 guard shape and approved source-derived retopology, with authored component rebuilds for armor shells, joints, and clothing where required.
authorship.skeleton_and_motion: The original GuardRig20 core and authored curves from original_guard_motion_build.py are preserved and rebound. Assembly-authored elbow support and TabardDrape helper curves are baked through all five clips. No third-party skeleton, mesh, motion capture, animation, or texture is permitted.
authorship.weapons: KingdomSteelSword and KingdomSunShield are project-original authored assets from the original guard motion source.

review_gates.blade_reach_at_attack_contact: Measure actual blade reach and world position relative to target; target must be reached and both feet planted.
review_gates.deformation: Inspect all five actions for hard armor distortion, arm joints, helmet clearance, source-fitted closed cloth leg lofts across knees, tabard gravity drape, tasset clearance, ground contact, and full-body silhouette.
review_gates.uv: Record assigned material tiles and reject visible square projection seams or excessive generated scratches.
review_gates.exports: Both LOD GLBs retain GuardRig20, all five expected action durations, both weapon objects, and identical rtsMotion scene extras.

source_rules.allowed: Project-authored shape/retopology/material/helmet/tabard/arm candidates and project-authored original weapon assets only.

runtime_assets.visual_review: Root reviewed the complete original guard, five actions, both LODs and team colors in the actual renderer.
runtime_assets.animation_review: Authored original clips and rig; both GLB scene rtsMotion records match the simulator timing contract.
known_visual_limits: LOD1 elbow/armor silhouette is coarser in closeups.
Tabard crease and fine metal-seam aliasing remain visible at close range.
Review sampled allfive actions and short playback, not exhaustive alltime allmesh collision proof.
Contact test covers guard-vs-guard single and4v1 in bothLODs, not every possible target model.
